purpose: Evidence-matched cross-taxon ecological-state research design; no new empirical re-estimation claimed

lanes.state: local clock time: six fixed 4-hour bins
lanes.supported: species-time organization after site accounting; positive transfer in 3 site folds
lanes.not_supported: causal competitive avoidance or fully detection-corrected activity probabilities

lanes.independent_unit: tracked individual and cross-night session, not GPS fixes
lanes.supported: repeatable individual altitude-shape information in five of six panels
lanes.not_supported: individual spatial exclusion, identified foraging preferences, universally stable fixed route, or shared causal process

lanes.state: continuous water depth at used vs matched nearby available locations
lanes.supported: experienced-depth buffering against matched nearby availability and post hoc heterogeneity association
lanes.not_supported: verified geographic move-to-stay-in-state causation, independently replicated portfolio threshold, or universal species rule

lanes.state: source-reported destination habitat categories (not source-defined origin state)
lanes.supported: published availability comparison is potentially useful for different retrospective questions
lanes.not_supported: origin-to-destination habitat-state retention or any new 4-species retention effect

nonnegotiable_constraints: No ecological effect computed from California without exact source-defined origin-state / step identifier.
Do not pool time, altitude and water-depth effect magnitudes into one ecological effect size.
Do not treat photographs, fixes, alternatives, or events as independent animals.
Do not call synthetic unit-test success or a conceptual ABM an empirical animal-mechanism result.
Do not reinterpret repeatable individual state-use probabilities as competitive exclusion or fitness adaptation.
Distinguish preregistered tests from post-hoc source mechanism diagnostics.
